description: Build a correctly percent-encoded mailto link from to, cc, bcc, subject and body fields, plus a ready to paste HTML anchor snippet. Spaces are encoded as %20 and line breaks as %0D%0A, as the mailto standard expects. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/email-link-generator/

bcc.description: Optional bcc addresses, separated by commas or semicolons

body.description: Optional body text; line breaks are preserved

cc.description: Optional cc addresses, separated by commas or semicolons

linkText.description: Optional visible text for the HTML anchor (default 'Email us')

to.description: One or more recipient addresses, separated by commas or semicolons

name: hopi_email_link_generator

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: Email link generator
